verdict.rationale: Phoenix documents a per-call token usage breakdown for finding the most expensive LLM invocations, and lets you group traces into conversations and user sessions. Projects organize traces by application or team, and span queries support filtering, so usage can plausibly be sliced by session. However, the pack never documents attaching custom metadata (user IDs, feature tags) to traces, aggregating cost per user or feature, or dollar-cost computation beyond tokens. Missing for 10: documented custom metadata/tag attributes on spans, per-user and per-feature cost or usage rollups, monetary cost tracking, independent corroboration.
